description: This file defines types, functions, and an async factory for creating an Ollama embedding provider, including API interaction, URL handling, secret resolution, and normalization logic.

methods.name: sanitizeAndNormalizeEmbedding
methods.description: Normalizes a vector of numbers by sanitizing non-finite values and normalizing its magnitude.

methods.name: buildRemoteBaseUrlPolicy
methods.description: Creates an SSRf policy based on a base URL, allowing only its hostname.

methods.name: withRemoteHttpResponse
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with SSRf guard and processes the response with a callback.

methods.name: normalizeEmbeddingModel
methods.description: Normalizes the model string, defaulting if empty or adding/removing prefix.

methods.name: resolveMemorySecretInputString
methods.description: Resolves secret input string from a value, if configured.

methods.name: resolveOllamaApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the API key for Ollama from secret inputs or environment.

methods.name: resolveOllamaEmbeddingClient
methods.description: Builds the client configuration including URL, headers, and SSRf policy.

methods.name: createOllamaEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Creates and returns an Ollama embedding provider and client with API interaction functions.
